title: Tech Note: Dynamic Web Document Management

historical_commentary.text: This note showcases 4D V6's then-new integrated Web server capability for creating and sending dynamic HTML documents, a genuinely novel feature for 4D at the time; the general concept of a database driving dynamic web content remains foundational, but the specific 1997 implementation predates 4D's built-in web server's decades of subsequent rearchitecture, HTTPS/HTTP2 support, and today's ORDA/REST-based web app patterns.
related_updates: 4D's built-in Web server has been substantially rearchitected many times since 1997, gaining HTTPS, better performance, and modern configuration options
Modern dynamic web development with 4D typically uses ORDA/REST APIs with client-side frameworks rather than server-side HTML generation as described in this early note
